name: Choose the One
body:
You may choose which trait that you receive from the We Are One racial trait.

Prerequisite: Xax, One of Few.

Benefit: Instead of rolling for your We Are One racial trait, you may choose one out of the list.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
